text.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًۭا مِّن قَبْلِكَ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا وَذُرِّيَّةًۭ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأْتِىَ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ لِكُلِّ أَجَلٍۢ كِتَابٌۭ

words.gloss_range: opening coordinator with resumptive force, linking the warning before it to a new proof-unit
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens with linkage and restart together: the ayah is not detached from 13:37, but it starts a fresh proof-unit from prophetic precedent. The particle carries the prior warning into a broader explanation of why messengerly humanity and sign-limitation belong together.

topics.headline: resumptive link after warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah starts a new argument while still carrying the pressure of 13:37 into prophetic precedent.
topics.reason: The source rows agree that the opening coordinator is an istiʾnāf-like restart with linkage to the preceding warning in 13:37.

words.gloss_range: emphatic lām fused to the following certification particle in the laqad assertion
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) is the emphatic lām in the compact laqad opening, not a preposition governing a noun. Before the verb arrives, the assertion of earlier sending is already strengthened against resistance.

topics.headline: emphatic lām certifies the premise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the historical sending claim as insistently certified before the content of that claim unfolds.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as emphatic lām before {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}), and the CRITICAL rows treat its compact fusion with qad as assertion-strengthening.

words.gloss_range: certification particle before a perfect verb, selecting realized precedent

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the emphatic particle paired with this certification particle

words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) with the perfect verb turns earlier sending into settled precedent, not a possibility. Together with {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}), it makes the opening claim a certified premise for the later denial of autonomous signs.

topics.headline: qad marks realized precedent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah argues from completed prophetic history rather than from a tentative reminder.
topics.reason: The particle stands before a perfect Form IV verb, so the tahqīq/completion force is locally licensed.

words.gloss_range: Form IV first-person plural perfect: God has dispatched messengers as an authorized act
words.root_gloss_range: broad sending field including dispatch, release, message, and messenger; locally selected as divine Form IV dispatch
words.prose: {{ar:أَرْسَلْنَا}} ({{tr:arsalnā}}) makes divine agency explicit in a completed Form IV dispatch: God is the sender before any messenger is an actor. The r-s-l field ties sender, message, and dispatched agent together, with a controlled-release pressure that is narrowed here to authorized mission; the same verb in 13:30 places the present Prophet inside the same sent line, while the boundary from 13:37 shifts divine control from sending down judgment to sending out messengers.

topics.headline: first-person plural perfect dispatch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that messengerhood begins from God’s completed act, so later sign-production cannot be owned by the messenger.
topics.reason: The Form IV perfect with first-person plural subject marks completed divine dispatch.

topics.headline: r-s-l mission field and provenance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a mission-chain of sender, message, and sent agent, while the broader release imagery is limited to authorized dispatch in this clause.
topics.reason: The rows connect r-s-l with messenger, sign, and permission language and with 13:30; the local verb form keeps the broad release image subordinate to divine dispatch.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative plural object: messengers as a real class before the addressee
words.root_gloss_range: r-s-l messenger field; locally plural sent agents, not autonomous sign-makers

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the dispatch verb that governs this plural object

words.prose: {{ar:رُسُلًا}} ({{tr:rusulan}}) is the indefinite accusative plural object of {{ar:أَرْسَلْنَا}} ({{tr:arsalnā}}), making the precedent class-wide rather than a single named case. Its plural form, qiraat lightening, and dispatch formula (2:151, 3:164, 62:2) keep messengerhood audible as a sent class, while the ayah’s r-s-l spine moves from sending verb to plural agents to the later singular rule-subject.

topics.headline: indefinite plural messenger class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that many unnamed messengers are in view, so the argument is class-wide before it becomes a universal rule.
topics.reason: The noun is an indefinite accusative plural object; the accepted lightened recitation preserves the same plural identity.

topics.headline: messenger dispatch formula and internal r-s-l spine
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah’s repeated r-s-l language binds sent agents to delegated authority, not autonomous wonder-working.
topics.reason: The rows link the phrase with dispatch formulae in 2:151, 3:164, and 62:2 and with the internal movement from {{ar:أَرْسَلْنَا}} ({{tr:arsalnā}}) to {{ar:رُسُلًا}} ({{tr:rusulan}}) to {{ar:رَسُولٍ}} ({{tr:rasūlin}}).

words.gloss_range: preposition selecting temporal anteriority before the addressee

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the governed temporal complement selected by this preposition

words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) governs {{ar:قَبْلِكَ}} ({{tr:qablika}}) and narrows its range to temporal anteriority. Source or partition senses remain only as background pressure: the precedent reaches the addressee from the earlier messenger-line, not from a partitive group.

topics.headline: min as governed temporal anteriority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition measures earlier messengers by time before the addressee, not by membership in a subgroup.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:قَبْلِكَ}} ({{tr:qablika}}) the governed complement of this preposition, selecting temporal anteriority and narrowing broader min ranges.

words.gloss_range: genitive temporal noun with second-person suffix: before you as a governed address anchor
words.root_gloss_range: q-b-l field of before, facing, receiving, and orientation; locally temporal anteriority with directional pressure
words.prose: {{ar:قَبْلِكَ}} ({{tr:qablika}}) fuses a governed time noun with the direct second-person suffix, making the Prophet the coordinate for prior messengers. The same addressed figure shifts from warned subject in 13:37 to time-anchor here. The q-b-l facing/orientation field is narrowed to time, but it still makes “before you” feel like a faced and passed prophetic direction; same-surah recurrences near 13:30 and 13:32 keep that continuity local.

topics.headline: governed time noun plus addressee suffix
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same addressed Prophet becomes the temporal anchor for the earlier messenger-line.
topics.reason: The word is genitive after {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) and carries a second-person masculine suffix, tying chronology to the addressee.

topics.headline: before as faced orientation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the root’s facing-orientation pressure behind temporal “before,” while local grammar keeps the selected sense temporal.
topics.reason: The q-b-l field supports facing and orientation, but the min-governed phrase in this ayah selects temporal anteriority; the same-surah echoes are 13:30 and 13:32.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction linking a second divine perfect clause to the sending clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the family-provision clause with the sending clause. The spouses and offspring therefore become coequal evidence of prophetic humanity, not ornamental biography after the real argument.

topics.headline: coordinating wa joins sending to family provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that family life is structurally joined to prophetic sending as part of the ayah’s evidence.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following clause as coordinated with the opening sending clause, and the CRITICAL rows identify the human provision as part of the same evidentiary package.

words.gloss_range: Form I first-person plural perfect of making/appointing, constituting family provision for messengers
words.root_gloss_range: j-ʿ-l range of making, appointing, rendering, and constituting; locally social constitution rather than creation from nothing
words.prose: {{ar:جَعَلْنَا}} ({{tr:jaʿalnā}}) shifts divine action from dispatch to social constitution: God makes or appoints spouses and offspring for the messengers. The verb is narrowed away from creation from nothing toward arranged human bonds, and it contrasts with false human making in 13:16 while echoing creation-pairing language in 13:3.

topics.headline: divine making of family provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that prophetic family life is divinely constituted within messengerhood, not a biographical afterthought.
topics.reason: The verb governs the family-provision clause and selects arrangement/constitution rather than origination from nothing.

topics.headline: divine making contrasted and echoed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader places this divine making against false human assignment in 13:16 and the paired-creation frame in 13:3.
topics.reason: The provenance rows connect j-ʿ-l here with 13:16 and with z-w-j pairing language in 13:3.

words.gloss_range: benefactive/allocation lām governing the plural pronoun for messenger recipients
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) routes the family provision toward the messengers as recipients. Its “for/to” range keeps benefit and possession both close, but the local phrase makes the spouses and offspring assigned to them within divine making.

topics.headline: lām routes provision to messengers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the family clause is not just about spouses existing; it assigns them for the messenger class.
topics.reason: The particle governs {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) and forms the recipient phrase inside the {{ar:جَعَلْنَا}} ({{tr:jaʿalnā}}) clause.

words.gloss_range: third-person plural pronoun governed by lām, resolving back to the messenger class

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the plural messenger antecedent carried by this pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) carries the plural messenger class from {{ar:رُسُلًا}} ({{tr:rusulan}}) into the family clause. Across the boundary from 13:37, denied protection gives way here to granted human supports, but the pronoun’s local antecedent is the messengers just named.

topics.headline: plural pronoun imports messengers into family clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the spouses and offspring are assigned to the same plural messengers introduced as precedent.
topics.reason: The pronoun is governed by {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) and resolves to the preceding plural messenger object; the boundary row adds the contrast with 13:37.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative plural made-object: spouses/pairs assigned to messengers
words.root_gloss_range: z-w-j range of spouse, pair, mate, and kind; locally spouses with complementarity pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the making verb that governs this accusative made-object

words.prose: {{ar:أَزْوَٰجًا}} ({{tr:azwājan}}) is the accusative made-object in the {{ar:جَعَلْنَا}} ({{tr:jaʿalnā}}) clause, left indefinite and plural so prophetic spouses are class-real but unnamed. The z-w-j field keeps spousehood tied to pairing and complementarity, resonates with 13:3 and 13:23 as well as prophet-family references in 21:90 and 25:74, and sits within the ayah’s larger making-to-totality movement.

topics.headline: spouses as indefinite made-object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices spouses as a real class of provision assigned in the grammar, not as named individual biography.
topics.reason: The noun is an indefinite accusative plural dependent in the {{ar:جَعَلْنَا}} ({{tr:jaʿalnā}}) clause.

topics.headline: spouse, pair, and kind pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that spousehood carries pair/complement language, linking prophetic humanity to the surah’s pairing motifs.
topics.reason: The rows preserve z-w-j polysemy and cite 21:90, 25:74, 13:3, and 13:23 as provenance for prophetic family and pairing language.

words.gloss_range: coordinator adding offspring as a second object in the family-provision clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) extends the spouse term rather than contrasting it. The coordination lets offspring arrive as the next part of the same family provision, moving from marriage bond to lineage continuity.

topics.headline: wa extends spouses into offspring
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the family argument expanding from spouses to descendants inside one coordinated divine provision.
topics.reason: The particle coordinates {{ar:ذُرِّيَّةً}} ({{tr:dhurriyyatan}}) with {{ar:أَزْوَٰجًا}} ({{tr:azwājan}}) as another accusative element in the family-provision clause.

words.gloss_range: singular collective accusative for offspring and descendants, coordinated with spouses

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the spouse term that precedes the offspring term

words.prose: {{ar:ذُرِّيَّةً}} ({{tr:dhurriyyatan}}) is a singular collective object: one form names a plural line of descendants. Its disputed derivational images of scattering seed or created offspring are narrowed to lineage here, while the qiraat variants expose vocalic pressure, including a hamza-like glottal catch; after {{ar:أَزْوَٰجًا}} ({{tr:azwājan}}), it completes the biological sequence from spouses to offspring.

topics.headline: singular collective offspring object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar names descendants collectively: a singular form carries plural lineage.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as an accusative singular collective, coordinated with {{ar:أَزْوَٰجًا}} ({{tr:azwājan}}).

topics.headline: lineage etymology and qiraat pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses lineage as spread and continuation, while the local role remains offspring rather than a free etymological image.
topics.reason: The rows preserve disputed derivation, accepted recitational form pressure, and the spouse-to-offspring sequence; those pressures are narrowed by the local accusative object role.

words.gloss_range: resumptive coordinator opening the negated capacity clause after human grants
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pivots from grants to limitation. After spouses and offspring humanize messengers, this wa opens the central restriction: humanity is granted, but sign-control is not.

topics.headline: resumptive wa pivots from grants to restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the argument turn from what messengers were given to what no messenger can independently do.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence starts a new negated kāna clause here, matching the CRITICAL rows’ argumentative-pivot claim.

words.gloss_range: negation particle scoping over kāna and preparing the exception construction

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the exception particle that completes the negation frame

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) begins the denial that will be completed by {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}). It selects negation, not question or relative force, and sets up qaṣr: the field of messenger sign-production is denied except through one authorized route.

topics.headline: mā denial prepares exclusive exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sentence is built as exclusion: no independent capacity remains once the exception is named.
topics.reason: The particle precedes {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) in a negated capacity clause and is completed by the later exception particle.

words.gloss_range: kāna in the mā kāna li-an construction, denying rightful or possible capacity
words.root_gloss_range: k-w-n existential/being field; locally capacity/existence under negation rather than simple past time
words.prose: {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) is not merely past-tense “was”; inside the mā kāna li-an frame it denies rightful possibility. That formulaic restriction, known from boundary-setting uses such as 3:161, 8:67, and 33:53, becomes the ayah’s central rule when joined to divine permission.

topics.headline: mā kāna li-an denies rightful possibility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah denies capacity or entitlement, not simply narrating that something did not happen before.
topics.reason: The verb sits in the negated mā kāna li-an construction, so local force is existential capacity under negation.

topics.headline: boundary-setting formula converges with permission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can place the restriction within a wider boundary-setting idiom while seeing that this ayah resolves the boundary through divine permission.
topics.reason: The source rows cite formula parallels in 3:161, 8:67, and 33:53 and connect the local restriction with {{ar:إِذْنِ}} ({{tr:idhni}}).

words.gloss_range: lām after negated kāna marking the agent whose capacity is denied
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) marks the logical holder of the denied action. Its broad “for/to” range narrows here into the lām of denial: the following messenger is exactly the one to whom independent sign-production is not available.

topics.headline: lām marks denied capacity-holder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices who is being denied capacity before the action itself is named.
topics.reason: The particle follows negated {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) and governs {{ar:رَسُولٍ}} ({{tr:rasūlin}}), marking the agent whose capacity is denied.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive singular messenger under negation, universalizing the rule
words.root_gloss_range: r-s-l messenger/delegated-agent field; locally any messenger as holder of denied sign-production
words.prose: {{ar:رَسُولٍ}} ({{tr:rasūlin}}) turns the earlier plural precedent into a singular rule-subject: no one in the messenger class owns the action. Its delegated-agent sense is crucial; a rasūl is sent with authority, but the grammar denies independent control over producing a sign.

topics.headline: singular indefinite messenger universalizes the denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from many prior messengers to any single messenger covered by the restriction.
topics.reason: The singular indefinite genitive under negation universalizes the class, moving from {{ar:رُسُلًا}} ({{tr:rusulan}}) to this rule-subject.

topics.headline: delegated agent cannot own signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that messengerhood itself implies delegated authority, which fits the denial of autonomous sign-production.
topics.reason: The rows connect r-s-l delegated-agent semantics with coming and permission roots in the local clause.

words.gloss_range: subordinator/nominalizer turning the following action into the denied capacity-content
words.prose: {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) converts the following sign-bringing action into the content of what is denied. The sentence is therefore not just negating a verb; it denies that such action belongs to a messenger’s capacity.

topics.headline: an turns action into denied capacity-content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sign-bringing is packaged as the very capacity the clause excludes.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the following imperfect clause as the governed complement of the negated capacity construction.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive imperfect after an: hypothetical bringing or producing of a sign
words.root_gloss_range: ʾ-t-y field of coming/arrival; with bāʾ locally means bring or produce, retaining arrival pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the subordinator that makes this action dependent
the bāʾ that shifts coming into bringing

words.prose: {{ar:يَأْتِيَ}} ({{tr:yaʾtiya}}) stays subjunctive and hypothetical under {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}), so the sign-bringing remains unrealized until permission is named. With {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}), the verb means bringing or producing a sign, but the arrival sense still presses inside it; that matters because the ayah contrasts received knowledge in 13:37 with denied production here, and the provenance contrast with 13:16 keeps autonomous human making in the background while this verb hinges messengerhood to divine permission.

topics.headline: subjunctive production remains unrealized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the action is grammatically held as a denied possibility, not an event performed by the messenger.
topics.reason: The imperfect is subjunctive after {D(20)}, and with bāʾ it selects bringing/producing rather than simple arrival.

topics.headline: arrival pressure and inter-root hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the arrival-root pressure inside sign-production, while the local construction keeps the action denied and permission-dependent.
topics.reason: The broader coming sense is narrowed by the bāʾ construction; the rows also connect this hinge with 13:16 and the boundary contrast from 13:37.

words.gloss_range: first bāʾ governing the sign as the brought object or accompaniment

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the verb whose valency this bāʾ completes

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) attaches the sign to the action of {{ar:يَأْتِيَ}} ({{tr:yaʾtiya}}). It holds accompaniment and transitive force together: the sign is what would be brought, not the means that authorizes bringing.

topics.headline: first bāʾ marks the brought sign
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the difference between the sign presented and the later permission that enables presentation.
topics.reason: The particle governs {{ar:آيَةٍ}} ({{tr:āyatin}}) in the sign-object phrase, distinct from the later instrumental bāʾ before {{ar:إِذْنِ}} ({{tr:idhni}}).

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive singular sign/proof/verse: any minimal sign under denial
words.root_gloss_range: ʾ-y-y/āya range of sign, proof, verse, mark, and disputed refuge image; locally proof-sign under denied production
words.prose: {{ar:آيَةٍ}} ({{tr:āyatin}}) is an indefinite singular under negation, so even one sign is beyond independent messenger control. Its range includes sign, proof, and verse: the ayah itself is a verse about signs as proof, while the refuge/mark dispute is narrowed here to proof-sign force. Same-surah sign language at 13:1, 13:2, 13:3, 13:4, 13:7, and 13:27 is gathered into an authorization model by the paired bāʾ phrases.

topics.headline: indefinite singular sign under denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial reaches the smallest token: not even a single sign is messenger-owned.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite genitive singular after {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) inside the negated capacity clause.

topics.headline: sign range and authorization network
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees sign language as proof-bearing and permission-bound, while broader root disputes do not override the local sign sense.
topics.reason: The rows preserve sign/proof/verse range, a root dispute, same-surah occurrences at 13:1, 13:2, 13:3, 13:4, 13:7, and 13:27, and the local link to {{ar:يَأْتِيَ}} ({{tr:yaʾtiya}}) and {{ar:إِذْنِ}} ({{tr:idhni}}).

words.gloss_range: exception particle completing the mā ... illā exclusivity over the whole denial
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) reaches back over the whole negated capacity clause. It does not make a loophole; it carves a single route, so sign-production is denied absolutely except through divine permission.

topics.headline: illā scopes over the whole denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exception narrows the entire field to one authorized route rather than merely qualifying the next word.
topics.reason: The particle completes the mā ... illā structure begun at {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) and points to {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) {{ar:إِذْنِ}} ({{tr:idhni}}) {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) as the sole route.

words.gloss_range: second bāʾ governing permission as the enabling means or condition
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is the second bāʾ, and it differs from the first bāʾ before the sign. The first marks what would be brought, while this one marks the enabling means: permission is the condition through which the sign can occur.

topics.headline: second bāʾ marks enabling means
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes the sign as object from permission as the enabling condition.
topics.reason: The particle governs {{ar:إِذْنِ}} ({{tr:idhni}}) and selects means/instrument rather than a carried object.

topics.headline: paired bāʾ phrases bind sign to authorization
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the structural mirror: one bāʾ phrase names the sign, the other names its authorization source.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly pair the two bāʾ phrases around {{ar:آيَةٍ}} ({{tr:āyatin}}) and {{ar:إِذْنِ}} ({{tr:idhni}}).

words.gloss_range: verbal noun permission in construct with the divine name, making authorization the governing principle
words.root_gloss_range: ʾ-dh-n field of ear, listening, announcement, and permission; locally divine authorization, with attentiveness/proclamation pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the proper divine name completing this construct phrase

words.prose: {{ar:إِذْنِ}} ({{tr:idhni}}) is the permission that enables the exception, and its construct with {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) makes the source specific. As a verbal noun, it names authorization as a principle, while the ʾ-dh-n field of ear, listening, and announcement gives that authorization the texture of attentive divine leave rather than bare administrative approval.

topics.headline: permission bound to God in construct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exception is not generic permission but God’s specific leave as the only operative condition.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) and forms an iḍāfa with {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}), matching the local co-occurrence of permission and divine name.

topics.headline: root field and masdar principle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices authorization as an abstract governing principle with hearing/proclamation pressure, while local sense remains permission.
topics.reason: The root-family and masdar rows survive as semantic pressure, but the construct phrase selects divine permission in the sign-production rule.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name in genitive completing the permission construct
words.root_gloss_range: ʾ-l-h worship/deity field with disputed w-l-h bewilderment pressure; locally the proper divine name
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) completes the construct and definitizes the source of permission. The proper name makes the exception exclusive in source: signs come by God’s authorization, not by messengerly office; the worship and bewilderment derivational dispute remains background pressure behind the named authority.

topics.headline: proper divine name as sole authorization source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the permission source is exactly named, so no anonymous authority or messengerly status can fill the slot.
topics.reason: The proper noun is genitive in the construct with {{ar:إِذْنِ}} ({{tr:idhni}}) and anchors the messenger-permission relation, including the boundary shift from 13:37 to 13:38.

topics.headline: disputed root memory behind the proper name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can retain worship/dependence pressure around the divine name without turning a proper name into a local derivational argument.
topics.reason: The row preserves a valid dispute as background only; the local form functions as the proper divine name in the construct.

words.gloss_range: fronted lām assigning each term its corresponding written decree
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) opens the closing nominal clause by fronting the allocation phrase. It assigns a book or decree to every term before the predicate appears, and its specification function differs from the earlier benefactive lām in the family-provision phrase.

topics.headline: fronted lām assigns book to each term
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears distribution before the predicate, so the closing lands as a rule over every term rather than a statement merely about a book.
topics.reason: The lām governs {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) in a fronted phrase before {{ar:كِتَابٌ}} ({{tr:kitābun}}), assigning the predicate to each term.

words.gloss_range: genitive universal quantifier in construct with term, distributing the rule over each instance
words.root_gloss_range: k-l-l totality/exhaustiveness field; locally every individual appointed term
words.prose: {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) supplies exhaustive scope, but in singular construct form it distributes one term at a time. The closing rule therefore includes every appointed term, and the echo of 13:2 extends the surah’s cosmic term-order into prophetic and historical order.

topics.headline: singular quantifier creates term-by-term totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that “every” works distributively: each appointed term individually falls under the decree.
topics.reason: The word is genitive after {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) and first term of an iḍāfa with {{ar:أَجَلٍ}} ({{tr:ajalin}}), formally singular but semantically exhaustive.

topics.headline: same-surah totalizing echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the final maxim to the surah’s broader totalizing language, especially the appointed-term frame of 13:2.
topics.reason: The rows cite same-surah kull recurrence and the 13:2 echo where cosmic motion runs to an appointed term.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive term governed by every, the distributed class receiving a decree
words.root_gloss_range: ʾ-j-l range of appointed term, endpoint, respite, deadline, and reason/cause; locally bounded appointed term with causal pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the distributive quantifier governing this term

words.prose: {{ar:أَجَلٍ}} ({{tr:ajalin}}) is the genitive term distributed by {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}), not the predicate. Its endpoint/deadline field gives the maxim bounded-time pressure, while the reason/cause branch is narrowed to appointedness: every term has a written setting, a nexus echoed in 6:2, 35:11, and the same-surah return from 13:2.

topics.headline: ajalin as distributed genitive class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that each indefinite term-instance is what receives the predicate, not a single known deadline.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite genitive as the second member of {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) {{ar:أَجَلٍ}} ({{tr:ajalin}}).

topics.headline: endpoint and decree nexus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the appointed endpoint as both limit and explanatory frame, while local sense remains an appointed term rather than a free “cause” meaning.
topics.reason: The rows preserve endpoint, deadline, and cause/reason range, plus term-decree links in 6:2, 35:11, and 13:2; local construct grammar selects appointed term.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative predicate of the closing verbless maxim: a written record/decree for every term
words.root_gloss_range: k-t-b range of writing, record, prescription, decree, and disputed sewing/joining image; locally written decree-record
words.prose: {{ar:كِتَابٌ}} ({{tr:kitābun}}) completes the fronted phrase as an indefinite nominative predicate: for every term, there is a written decree-record. The verbless construction makes the line axiomatic; writing, prescription, and even the disputed joining image concretize decree as inscribed and bound, while surah-local book language at 13:1, 13:36, 13:39, and 13:43 ties the sign-limitation to a book-governed frame. Its tanwīn also joins the ayah’s indefinite class nouns: messengers, spouses, offspring, sign, and decree.

topics.headline: verbless predicate states a universal axiom
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the closure as a timeless maxim that generalizes the messenger-specific restriction.
topics.reason: The word is the nominative predicate after fronted {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) {{ar:أَجَلٍ}} ({{tr:ajalin}}), forming a verbless universal clause.

topics.headline: record and decree collapse into written prescription
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that record and decree are not separated here: the term is both documented and authoritatively set.
topics.reason: The lexical rows support book, record, prescription, decree, and a disputed joining image; local context selects written decree-record, with formula provenance in 6:2 and 3:145.

topics.headline: surah book thread and indefinite cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final indefinite noun join the ayah’s class-noun cadence while reconnecting to the surah’s book language.
topics.reason: The rows cite book-language at 13:1, 13:36, 13:39, and 13:43 and the tanwīn thread linking {{ar:رُسُلًا}} ({{tr:rusulan}}), {{ar:أَزْوَٰجًا}} ({{tr:azwājan}}), {{ar:ذُرِّيَّةً}} ({{tr:dhurriyyatan}}), {{ar:آيَةٍ}} ({{tr:āyatin}}), and {{ar:كِتَابٌ}} ({{tr:kitābun}}).

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The first clause joins sent messengers to spouses and descendants.
baseline_models.mechanism: Commission is an office carried inside ordinary paired and generative life, not a condition that removes its bearer from household continuity.

activation_trace.role: A message and its carrier supply the commissioned office, separating function from the messenger's human constitution.
Making something occupy a condition supplies the placement of messengers within a household state.
The marital spouse supplies the concrete paired household that coexists with commission.

changed_reading.before: Earlier messengers are merely precedents for the present messenger.
changed_reading.after: They are precedents whose commissioned office normally coexists with marriage and posterity; embodiment is part of the prophetic pattern, not a rebuttal to it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The middle clause denies a messenger independent capacity to bring a sign and makes divine permission the exception.
baseline_models.mechanism: Carrier, arrival, visible marker, and license form an authorization chain: the messenger can present, but does not own the sign's issuance or efficacy.

activation_trace.role: The carrier of a message supplies the bounded human role in the chain.
Giving or bringing something supplies presentation of the sign rather than its autonomous manufacture.
A manifest marker supplies the identifying evidence being requested or delivered.
License to act supplies the gate that makes presentation possible without transferring authority to the messenger.

changed_reading.after: The clause specifies an authorization protocol: a commissioned carrier may present an identifying sign only through licensed access, so nonproduction on demand is role fidelity rather than failure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing nominal clause pairs every appointed limit with a book.
baseline_models.mechanism: Distributive totality, a bounded duration, and an inscription that fixes judgment turn time into indexed appointments rather than an undifferentiated flow.

activation_trace.role: Comprehensive inclusion supplies the one-by-one coverage of all appointed spans.
A prescribed temporal limit supplies the bounded unit being indexed.
An inscription that establishes judgment or decree supplies the register attached to each limit.

changed_reading.before: Events merely occur at some destined time.
changed_reading.after: Each bounded term is paired with its own registered determination, giving time a docketed rather than merely fatalistic structure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence sent-messengers-before-spouses-descendants combines succession with generation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Successive dispatch, temporal precedence, pairing, and dispersal make prophetic history resemble a relay that propagates beyond any single envoy.

activation_trace.role: Successive groups supply serial rather than isolated dispatch.
Temporal precedence supplies depth behind the present commission.
One joined to a counterpart supplies the paired unit from which continuity proceeds.
Scattering grain supplies an exploratory dispersal image for posterity extending the relay.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists exceptional individuals followed by incidental family facts.
changed_reading.after: It can also stage waves of commissioned persons embedded in paired lines whose continuity disperses past each individual.

context_deltas.mechanism: Paired fruit, kin shoots from one origin, measured gestation, and the later reunion of spouses and descendants enlarge the focus household into a regulated branching continuity.

activation_trace.role: Joined counterparts supply the pair architecture shared by fruit and the focus household.
Joining one to one to make two intensifies pairing as a productive arrangement.
Close kin from one origin supply branching sameness and difference within a lineage.
Hidden pregnancy and fruit supply the concealed generative process behind descendants.
The womb supplies the material site where household continuity develops.
A measure reaching its limit supplies bounded regulation of increase and decrease.
Subtle distributed emergence supplies posterity reappearing within a multi-generation destination.

structural_cues: 13:3 places pair directly beside two, while 13:8 encloses pregnancy and uterine change between distributive totality and measure.
13:23 repeats spouses and descendants beside parents, turning the focus pair into a three-generation sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pairing, common-origin kin, gestation, measure, and repeated family terms; I infer that these form a continuity mechanism around prophetic households. A live alternative is looser thematic reassurance about creation and reward.

changed_reading.before: Spouses and descendants are an apologetic biographical aside.
changed_reading.after: They locate messengers inside the same measured, branching generativity displayed across fruit, wombs, kin, and restored generations.

context_deltas.mechanism: The present sending enters communities preceded by communities and converts concealed divine delivery into recitation; the focus's earlier messengers become links in a social and verbal relay.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch and release supply the commissioning motion into a community.
Communities or kinds supply the collective stations through which the relay passes.
Precedence supplies ordered historical depth between successive communities.
Following in sequence supplies recitation as an act that carries received content onward.
A divine report or inspiration supplies the content entrusted to the relay.
Successive groups supply repeated envoy cohorts under the same pattern of reception and resistance.

structural_cues: 13:30 orders sent, community, prior communities, recite, and revealed in one sequence.
13:32 repeats messengers before you, closely anticipating the focus opening.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies chronological communities and a receive-to-recite sequence; I infer a relay linking social succession to verbal transmission. The alternative is that prior communities serve only as precedent for consolation.

changed_reading.before: Before you only establishes that other messengers existed.
changed_reading.after: Before you gives the present commission relay depth: messages pass through successive communities and carriers, with household posterity nested inside that broader continuity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated demands for a sign escalate into imagined spectacular effects, but authority remains divine, the messenger's assignment contracts to delivery, and final validation arrives through witness and book-knowledge.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying marker supplies the demanded proof that pressures the messenger's role.
The same manifest-marker branch supplies repetition of the demand rather than new authority to satisfy it.
Reading and recitation supply the revealed vehicle placed inside the spectacular counterfactual.
Sovereign authority supplies ownership of efficacy after the imagined spectacles.
Delivering a message supplies the messenger's expressly bounded assignment.
The denied status of message-carrier supplies the final dispute the verse answers.
Testimony grounded in knowledge supplies an evidentiary answer other than self-produced spectacle.
The written text supplies a knowable witness-bearing medium at the close of the dispute.

structural_cues: 13:7 and 13:27 repeat the same sign-demand; 13:31 escalates to moved mountains, split earth, and addressed dead before reserving all command to God.
13:40 balances upon you delivery against upon Us account, and 13:43 answers denial of commission with witness and knowledge of the book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated pressure, spectacular hypotheticals, reserved authority, bounded delivery, and witness; I infer a deliberate division of labor. The live alternative is a set of separate consolations rather than one role protocol.

changed_reading.before: Permission is a generic theological caveat on miracles.
changed_reading.after: Permission protects a contested division of labor: demanders cannot set the sign schedule, the messenger delivers rather than controls efficacy, and commission can be validated by witnessed knowledge instead of spectacle.

context_deltas.mechanism: Named terms and measured processes feed into the focus's term-book pairing; the immediately following erasure, confirmation, and source-book language makes that register layered rather than uniformly static.

activation_trace.role: A prescribed temporal limit supplies an earlier concrete instance of a named cosmic term.
Deliberate apportioning supplies governance behind bounded changes rather than inert chronology.
Removal of a trace supplies revision at the level of what has been inscribed or manifested.
Durable stability supplies the contrasting preservation of selected entries.
An origin, collector, and point of return supplies a source register behind changeable entries.
Binding inscription or decree supplies continuity between the focus register and its source level.

structural_cues: 13:39 immediately follows the term-book clause and coordinates erasing with establishing before locating the mother of the book with God.
13:2 and 13:8 place terms and measures inside ongoing cosmic and reproductive processes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies term, measure, erasure, confirmation, and a source-book; I infer a two-level ledger in which entries can change while their governing source remains. A live alternative is that 13:39 concerns rulings or revelations rather than the individual terms of 13:38.

changed_reading.before: Every term is one immutable line in a flat predestination ledger.
changed_reading.after: Each term is registered within a layered administration: particular inscriptions may be erased or confirmed while an originating register remains with God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promised event has an appointment, the messenger may or may not live to see it, delivery remains his task, and accounting remains divine; the focus term-book therefore supports several coordinated but nonidentical clocks.

activation_trace.role: Arrival supplies fulfillment reaching its own due point.
A promise bounded by time or place supplies an appointment distinct from the messenger's control.
A spoken promise opening expectation supplies the event the messenger may see only in part.
Message delivery supplies the messenger's clock-independent obligation.
Counting and reckoning supply a further schedule retained by God.

structural_cues: 13:40 explicitly disjoins showing some of the promise from causing the messenger to die, then divides delivery from account.
13:31 says the promise arrives and its appointment is not broken.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a promised arrival, possible messenger death, delivery, and account; I infer distinct due clocks coordinated by the term-book. The alternative is simple consolation with no administrative model.

changed_reading.before: The appointed term refers to one generic deadline.
changed_reading.after: The verse permits separate registered deadlines for the messenger's life, a promised manifestation, and reckoning; faithfulness does not require those clocks to coincide.

context_deltas.mechanism: The joining branch of book is activated by a sequence of pact, fastening, commanded connection, family reunion, and unbinding; a term's book can be carried as a relational bond as well as a written schedule.

activation_trace.role: Joining pieces and stitching material supplies the exploratory binding image attached to a term.
A preserved pact supplies the commitment the relational binding must hold.
A confirmed covenant supplies fastening rather than mere association.
Joining one thing until it adheres to another supplies the positive relational operation.
Joined counterparts supply family as one concrete content of connection.
Distributed emergence supplies family connection extending across generations.
Unbinding what was made firm supplies the negative operation that can rupture the bond.

structural_cues: 13:20-25 orders pact, non-unbinding, commanded connection, intergenerational family, then unbinding and cutting.
The family reunion of 13:23 lies inside that connect-versus-cut sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies material joining in the book branch and a contextual bond/unbind sequence; I infer that the focus book can image a binding that holds commissioned and family continuity for its term. The live alternative is that book remains only decree or scripture.

changed_reading.before: The book is only a static record assigned to a deadline.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is also the binding that gathers obligations and generations into a term-governed continuity capable of being kept or torn.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because non-dominant branches of the recitation root evoke a womb gathering pregnancy and a time becoming due. It remains anchored because 13:38 explicitly juxtaposes spouses, descendants, bringing a sign, an appointed term, and a book, while 13:8 supplies actual gestation. Render only as a cross-domain temporal analogy, not as a lexical gloss or claim that revelation is literally pregnancy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The movement from spouses and descendants to bringing a sign and then to an appointed book permits a shared development-to-due-time pattern.

activation_trace.role: A womb gathering a pregnancy supplies the contained analogy of revealed content being gathered before emergence.
A time that becomes due or is delayed supplies the analogy's maturation clock.
Hidden pregnancy and fruit supply an explicit contextual development process.
Joined counterparts supply the focus's generative starting condition.
A prescribed limit supplies the due time at which development can issue.
Gathering and joining pieces supplies the contained image of collected content.

changed_reading.before: The household clause and the sign-term clause are unrelated defenses.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory analogy, both describe formed content developing inside bounds and emerging only at its licensed due time.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the water-basin sense of appointed term and the channel sense of bringing. It remains visibly anchored in the focus roots and is reinforced by 13:17's measured flood, valley channels, and persistence. Downstream prose should mark it as a hydrological systems analogy, never as the direct translation of the clause.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Permission to bring a sign and the term-book pairing can be modeled as controlled release through a scheduled channel.

activation_trace.role: A basin that gathers water before sending it to crops supplies storage followed by timed release.
A watercourse and the routing of its flow supply the channel through which an effect arrives.
A binding determination supplies the release schedule rather than the water itself.
Flood flow supplies the moving material whose release must be routed.
A valley as flood channel supplies differentiated pathways for the same incoming flow.
Capacity reaching its limit supplies channel-specific measure.
Stability with waiting supplies what remains after transient overflow passes.

changed_reading.before: Permission and the written term are abstract restrictions.
changed_reading.after: As a contained systems image, signs and events are stored, measured, routed, and released through appointed channels; the messenger is a conduit, not the reservoir or scheduler.

strongest_changes: The household clause became measured intergenerational continuity rather than an apologetic biographical aside.
The sign clause became a contested authorization and role boundary, ending in delivery, witness, and book-knowledge rather than spectacle on demand.
The term-book clause became a layered register with mutable entries and separate clocks for messenger, promise, and account.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots linked family generation, revelatory relay, authorized arrival, and scheduled inscription without forcing them into one final reading; non-dominant branches also exposed contained gestational and hydrological analogies.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 13:39's erasure and confirmation directly revise the individual term-books of 13:38 or another class of decree or revelation.
Whether the family-revelation parallels are intended structure or only productive branch resonance.
Whether book in the focus foregrounds decree, record, scripture, material binding, or several of these at once.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. `ء ذ ن/B004` is authorization. A messenger brings a sign only by permission, and each term has a book. Against haste and respite, I infer authorization coordinating event with appointed time; the phrase is temporal-causal licensing.
2. `ك ت ب/B003` is binding decree; `ء ج ل/B001` is fixed term. I infer a schedule-binding record while preserving written book (`ك ت ب/B002`). Family succession places messengers inside, not outside, temporal continuity.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 13:39 immediately complicated the schedule by pairing erasure and establishment, forcing decree to be read under continuing divine agency.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Messengers continue in human batches, but signs remain authorization-bound.** `ر س ل / B005` is succession in batches, `ز و ج / B003` is pairing or joining someone with another, `ذ ر ر / B004` is gentle spreading emergence, and `ء ذ ن / B004` is permission and authorization. The first half embeds messengers in spouses and descendants; the second denies each messenger autonomous sign-production. Nearby 13:33 challenges unsupported naming, 13:36-37 define the message's reception and judgment, and 13:40 limits the messenger to delivery whether or not promised events become visible in his lifetime. I assign family formation the role of ordinary historical continuity and authorization the role of limiting extraordinary agency. The packet supplies succession, lineage, and permission; I infer human continuity -/-> autonomous control of signs. The ayah normalizes the messenger's life while sharply locating sign causality elsewhere.

2. **Each term is coupled to a binding record.** `ك ت ب / B003` is inscription as binding decree or judgment, and `ك ت ب / B001` is joining one thing to another. The distributive `لِكُلِّ أَجَلٍ كِتَابٌ` joins each term to a record immediately before 13:39's erasure, confirmation, and source-book. I assign the book the role of binding event to temporal slot. The packet supplies term and inscription; I infer recorded coupling -> events occur by ordered authorization rather than messenger demand. The line thus reads as scheduling architecture, not a detached proverb about books.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 13:39 immediately complicated “a book for every term” with erasure, confirmation, and a mother-source, revealing layered scheduling rather than a single flat record. 13:40 then confirmed the agency boundary: delivery persists even when the messenger cannot trigger or outlive the promised sign.

Her sürenin kaydı, daha sonra silinebilen ya da sabit bırakılan yerel olayları belirli zaman yuvalarına bağlayan katmanlı bir takvimdir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: permission and licensing (`quranic:root_000022:B004/m01`); binding command (`quranic:root_000051:B002/m01`); messenger and message (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); arrival or bringing (`quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`); delivery of a sign or book (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m02`).

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Command, license, dispatch, arrival, and delivered object form a complete commission. Permission defines the messenger's operating boundary.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, ortak çekirdeği bir varlığı harekete geçirip göndermek ya da elde tutmayı bırakıp salmak olarak kurar. İnsan, elçi, rüzgar, yağmur ve başka güçler bu işlemin farklı nesneleridir; bunlar ayrı birer çekirdek anlam değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gönderme ve serbest bırakmayı kapsar; yalnızca yavaşlık, süt veya sürü bildiren eşsesli kullanımları kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın gönderme ve salıverme çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; öteki dallardaki kalıba bağlı anlamlar buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanı, canlıyı, doğal gücü ya da başka bir şeyi bulunduğu yerden harekete geçirip bir yöne göndermek; kimi bağlamlarda elde tutmayı bırakıp serbestçe gitmesine izin vermektir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir varlığı durduğu veya tutulduğu konumdan çıkarıp ileri yöneltmektir.
Bir kişi görev veya haber için, rüzgar ve yağmur gibi güçler de etkilerini göstermek üzere gönderilebilir.
Tutmanın karşıtı olarak kullanım, eldeki canlıyı ya da denetlenen gücü salıvermeyi anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, harekete geçirip yollama çekirdeğinde birleşir; görevle gönderme, doğal güçleri yöneltme ve tutulanı serbest bırakma bu çekirdeğin kapsam içi gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_gloss.text: bir şeyi gönderme veya serbest bırakma
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın görevle yollama ile tutmayı bırakıp salıverme biçimlerinin ikisini de birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Hareket başlatma, yöneltme ve tutmayı bırakma seçeneklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi, elçi, rüzgar veya yağmur bir hedefe yöneltildiğinde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir varlığı harekete geçirip bir yöne yollamayı korur.
error_profile.loses: Elde tutulanı yalnızca serbest bırakma anlamını tek başına göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tutulan bir canlı veya denetlenen bir güç üzerindeki engel kaldırıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tutmayı bırakıp serbest hareket imkanı verme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Görevle veya haber taşımak üzere gönderme yönünü kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, doğal güçlerin yöneltilmesini ve tutulan bir şeyin salıverilmesini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, bir kişi, hayvan veya topluluğun belirli bir ihtiyaç ya da hedef için görevlendirilerek yollanmasına bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir varlığın bir hedefe doğru hareket ettirilmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın serbest bırakma ve doğal güçleri gönderme alanı daha geniştir; komşu dalın çekirdeği ise amaçlı görevlendirmedir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, haber veya görev için yollamayı da açıkça içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, engeli kaldırma, yol açma ve çözme gibi daha genel kolaylaştırma biçimlerine uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de bir varlığın tutulmadan hareket etmesine imkan verebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta gönderme işlemi kurucudur; komşuda asıl vurgu hareketi engelleyen bağı kaldırmaktır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal gönderme veya salıverme eylemini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal gönderilen haber taşıyıcısını ya da taşınan haberin kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı gönderici, taşıma ve hedef senaryosunda buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Eylem ile o eylemin taşıyıcısı veya içeriği birbirinin yerine kullanılamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aynı dal içinde iki açık gönderim öğesi verir: gönderenin sözünü taşıyan kişi ve taşınan söz ya da haber. Çerçeve bu düzenli kişi-içerik ayrımını doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, haber taşıyıcısı ile taşınan iletiyi kapsar; gönderme eylemini, sürüyü veya kolay yürüyüşü kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalda haber taşıyan kişi ile taşınan içeriği birlikte gösterir; özel kalıplardaki eşsesli anlamlar eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir gönderenin sözünü veya haberini başka birine götüren kişi ya da bu kişinin taşıdığı söz, haber ve iletidir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, bir gönderenden bir alıcıya içerik taşıyan ileti bağını kurar.
Kişi okumasında, taşıyıcı gönderen adına haberleri izleyen ve aktaran görevlidir.
İçerik okumasında sözcük, taşıyıcının götürdüğü sözün veya haberin kendisini belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, gönderici ile alıcı arasındaki aktarımı hem taşıyıcı kişi hem de taşınan söz bakımından kurar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın kişi ile içerik arasında kurduğu iki yönlü adlandırmayı en kısa biçimde birlikte verir.

error_profile.preserves: Hem gönderen adına hareket eden kişiyi hem de onun taşıdığı iletiyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz veya haber taşıyan kişinin kastedildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gönderen adına haber taşıyan kişi yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Taşınan sözün veya haberin kendisini adlandırmaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Taşınan sözün veya haberin kendisi kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Göndericiden alıcıya taşınan içerik yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: İçeriği taşıyan kişiyi adlandırmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kolay ve zorlamasız ilerleyişi; yumuşak eklem ve bacakları; düz, salık saçı aynı akıcılık niteliği çevresinde toplar. Çerçeve, yürüyüşü tek başına bütün dal saymadan bu ortak niteliği doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, harekette ve uzanışta yumuşak akıcılığı kapsar; gönderme, süt ve ardışık topluluk anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak akıcılık niteliğini verir; yürüyüş, hayvan bacakları, saç ve uzun bacak anlatımları kendi sözcük veya kalıp sınırlarında ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Hareketin zorlamasız, rahat ve akıcı olması ya da bir uzvun veya saçın sertçe kıvrılmadan yumuşakça uzanmasıdır.

facets.statement: Ortak nitelik, direnç ve sertlik göstermeyen rahat bir akış veya uzanıştır.
Yürüyüşte bu nitelik, hayvanı zorlamayan kolay ve akıcı ilerleyiş olarak görünür.
Bacaklar ve eklemler için yumuşaklık, saç için düz ve salık uzanma anlatılır.
Deve topluluğuna uygulandığında hızlı ya da kolayca harekete geçen sürüler kastedilebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kolay yürüyüş, yumuşak eklem ve bacaklar, salık saç ve rahatça ilerleyen deve topluluklarını dirençsiz akıcılık çevresinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yürüyüş, uzuv ve saç gerçekleşmelerini tek bir fiziksel nitelik altında kapsayan kavramsal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kolay ilerleme ile sert olmayan, salık uzanma arasındaki ortak niteliği korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir hayvanın veya topluluğun zorlanmadan ilerlemesi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dirençsiz ve kolay hareket niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Saçın veya uzuvların yumuşak ve salık oluşunu kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Saçın sertçe kıvrılmadan aşağı doğru uzanması anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yumuşak ve serbest uzanma niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kolay yürüyüş ve yumuşak eklem yönlerini kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iş, konuşma ve okumada aceleyi bırakıp sakin, ölçülü ve denetimli ilerlemeyi ortak çekirdek yapar. Çerçevedeki yavaşlık, ağırbaşlılık ve dikkat bu çekirdeğin birbirini tamamlayan yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, acele etmeden ölçülü davranma ve okumayı kapsar; ardışık topluluk veya taşınan ileti anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel temkin niteliği korunur; yavaş ol buyruğu, iş ve konuşmadaki tutum ile okumadaki açık söyleyiş kendi kullanım sınırlarında ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Bir işi, konuşmayı veya okumayı aceleye getirmeden; sakinlik, ağırbaşlılık, dikkat ve denetimle yürütmektir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, aceleyi bırakıp ölçülü ve denetimli ilerlemektir.
İş ve konuşmada sakinlik, ağırbaşlılık ve karar vermeden önce sağlamlaştırma öne çıkar.
Okumada metni acele etmeden açık, belirgin ve dikkatli söyleme kastedilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, acele etmeme buyruğunu ve iş, konuşma, okuma alanlarındaki sakin, dikkatli ilerleyişi ortak bir ölçülülük çekirdeğinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İş, konuşma ve okuma alanlarında ortak olan sakinlik ve denetim niteliğini verir.

error_profile.preserves: Acele etmeme, sakinlik, dikkat ve kontrollü ilerleme bileşenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiye yavaşlaması ve işi ölçülü yürütmesi söylendiğinde doğal buyruktur.

error_profile.preserves: Acele etmeme ve sakin davranma isteğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Okumadaki açık söyleyiş ve işteki sağlamlaştırma ayrıntılarını belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Metnin acele edilmeden açık ve belirgin biçimde okunması bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Okumada yavaşlık, açıklık ve denetimi korur.
error_profile.loses: İş ve genel konuşmadaki ağırbaşlı tutumu kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insan veya hayvanların tek bir kütle halinde değil, biri ötekinin ardından gelen ayrı kümeler halinde gelişini ve bu kümelerin her birini anlatır. Çerçeve, topluluk ile ardışıklık bileşenlerini birlikte korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, peş peşe gelen ayrı toplulukları ve sürüleri kapsar; haber taşıyıcısını veya sütün kendisini kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ardışık topluluk çekirdeğini korur; tek sürü adı ile grup grup gelme anlatımı kendi sözcük biçimlerinde ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: İnsanların, develerin, koyunların veya başka varlıkların ayrı topluluklar halinde, bir küme ötekinin ardından gelecek biçimde ilerlemesi ya da bu kümelerin her biridir.

facets.statement: Kurucu yapı, birbirini izleyen ayrı toplulukların oluşturduğu ardışıklıktır.
